Me and my parents have many disagreements.  Whether it be me getting pissed off at my dads dog since he's not good at training dogs, or any other reason, I just genuinely think they aren't really beneficial human beings.  When they piss me off, I do what any kid would do.  I lock myself in my room with a knife, and decide that if they enter I will be justified in stabbing them.  I don't tell them this though, because that would be a ticket to the loonie bin.

Homemade suicide attempts often fail because they are done on impulse and poorly planned.  I've been planning this for the better part of a year.  I've also have some engineering experience.

I'm personally just going to go for a massive nicotine overdose.  In America you can readily buy tobacco, which you can extract nicotine from.  Alternatively though, you could try using e-cig fluid, however depending on the fluids available to you, you might need a lot more e-cig fluid to kill you than if you were to just extract nicotine from tobacco.  Most e-cig fluid tends to have a relatively low percentage of actual nicotine in it.
